title: What is NuGet?
description: An introduction to NuGet, the package manager for .NET.

data.text: NuGet is the package manager for .NET. It enables developers to create, share, and consume useful .NET libraries. NuGet packages are distributed through the nuget.org gallery or private feeds.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install a package using the .NET CLI.

terms.definition: A .nupkg file containing compiled code, content files, and metadata.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: NuGet is essential for .NET development, providing access to thousands of libraries.
